review_candidates.title: Technician, Processing
review_candidates.description: Workplace Type: Onsite Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference. Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods. We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact. Purpose As a Technician, Processing, you’ll play a key role in operating critical sections of the process plant, including grinding circuits, flotation, and thickener operations. Your work ensures safety, efficiency, and production targets are met shift by shift, contributing directly to Newmont’s operational success. Essential Duties Prioritize Safety: Ensure compliance with all HSE policies, report hazards, and actively monitor plant conditions. Collaborate Effectively: Work constructively with diverse teams and participate in shift handovers, toolbox meetings, and training. Drive Production: Operate plant equipment, complete inspections, and maintain housekeeping standards. Control Costs: Identify and report cost-saving opportunities and minimize waste. Training & Experience Proven experience in heavy industry, preferably mining (essential). Grade 10 education minimum. Tertiary qualifications and metalliferous processing certificates are highly regarded. Class 6 PNG Driver’s License. Strong communication, attention to detail, time management, and technical knowledge in mineral processing. Safety-conscious, proactive problem solver, team player, and adaptable to changing work conditions. Working Conditions This is a FIFO role on a 28:14 rotating roster. At Newmont, our people are our strength and we’re committed to a safe, inclusive and supportive workplace. If you’re passionate about doing work that matters, join Newmont and help shape the future of mining. Learn more about our purpose and values: About Newmont Hear from our people: Life at Newmont Important: Newmont does not ask candidates to pay money or share sensitive personal data outside our secure application process. If this happens, please report it to our Business Integrity team: it.sec@newmont.com.

review_candidates.title: Systems Architect
review_candidates.description: About the Organisation Our client is an established, high-technology electronics and engineering business based in Shrivenham, Wiltshire. The organisation designs and manufactures bespoke and off-the-shelf product lines across telecommunications, defence, and power/electrification markets, working with product management, business development, and a varied customer base to shape and deliver its next generation of high-performance products. The business combines a big-business mentality with a small-business culture. A close-knit engineering team where people are given genuine opportunity to develop their careers and specialisms. Role Overview Systems Architects engage with the problem space at the earliest possible stage - whether that's responding to product management on new roadmap ideas, supporting business development on invitations to tender, or working directly with customers to capture requirements. The role drives the capture and maturation of product specifications from initial concept through to manufacture. Reporting to the Chief Engineer, the Systems Architect decomposes system and sub-system requirements, underpinning collaboration with the wider development team. The role guides technical activity, reviews team designs, and orchestrates the verification activities required to evidence the organisation's solutions across telecommunications, custom defence, and power/electrification product lines. Key Responsibilities Develop new product concepts from inception through to manufacture Conduct modelling and analysis to ensure products meet the rigorous demands of end users Decompose system and sub-system requirements to underpin collaboration across development teams Guide technical activities and review team designs to orchestrate verification and evidence solutions Team with engineers to resolve technical requirements arising from development activities Engage with product management, business development, and customers to capture and mature product specifications Share and disseminate personal expertise throughout the technical team Drive continuous improvement of the engineering department's functional capability Essential Skills and Experience Honours degree in a relevant engineering discipline, with many years of design practice First-class expertise in designing products for manufacture Whole-system knowledge of state-of-the-art radio architectures Solid grounding across all aspects of engineering, beyond a single specialist discipline Desirable Skills and Experience Background in the design of telecommunications networks Experience architecting full-stack software for custom hardware solutions Familiarity with engineering quality management processes and design for regulatory compliance Qualifications An honours degree in a relevant engineering discipline is essential Extensive, demonstrable design practice experience is required Person Specification Technical depth in a specific engineering discipline is a defining characteristic of this role, but the organisation equally values the ability to operate across the full breadth of engineering. The successful candidate will bring creativity and a passion for continuous improvement, a can-do attitude focused on completing tasks, and strong collaborative relationships built on trust and respect. They will listen to different perspectives to evaluate, shape, or persuade technical direction, enjoy teaching and sharing knowledge while learning from others, and consistently put company goals ahead of individual or team interests. Remuneration and Benefits Company bonus scheme, sharing in the wider success of the business Company pension scheme Option to purchase additional annual leave Tax-efficient share purchase plan rewarding long tenure Cycle-to-work scheme Employee assistance programme covering family wellbeing Annual summer and Christmas events, plus informal team socials Eligibility Requirements Due to the nature of the products our client is working on and the Security clearance needed - Sole British Nationals are required for this role. This appointment is being managed exclusively by Banner Lane Ltd on behalf of the client organisation. Interested candidates are invited to apply via LinkedIn or to contact the recruiting consultant directly for a confidential discussion.

Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world! NVIDIA is seeking architects to drive architectural performance for its next-generation AI server systems. This position demands a unique capability to bridge deep architectural knowledge, workload analysis, and hands-on silicon investigations. Candidates should be adept at working directly with silicon, high-level models, and simulators. Responsibilities include conducting performance investigations on both NVIDIA and competitive platforms, and developing targeted microbenchmarks to examine specific architectural aspects. The role does not heavily involve modeling tasks (functional or performance), though occasional focused assignments may arise. What You’ll Be Doing Defining and driving server-level performance targets across CPU, GPU, memory, interconnect, networking, and storage subsystems Conducting hands-on workload characterisation and bottleneck analysis on NVIDIA and competitive server platforms using AI training, inference, and HPC benchmarks Leveraging profiling, tracing, and analysis tools to root-cause performance issues and identify optimisation opportunities at the system level Performing trade-off studies on system topology, thermal/power envelopes, and memory hierarchy to guide architectural decisions Collaborating with silicon, platform, firmware, and software teams to identify and close performance gaps from bring-up through production Developing automation and tooling for performance regression tracking and reporting Representing the performance perspective in architecture reviews and cross-functional design discussions Building and maintaining analytical performance models and simulation frameworks for next-generation server platforms Publishing internal performance studies and best-practice guides for partner and customer enablement What We Need To See BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience 10+ years of experience in server/system performance architecture or related disciplines Deep understanding of modern server architectures — CPU microarchitecture, PCIe/CXL, DDR/HBM memory subsystems, and coherency protocols Strong hands-on experience with system-level profiling and performance analysis tools on server platform(s) Solid knowledge of GPU-accelerated compute, high-performance networking, or high-performance storage subsystems Proficiency in Python, C/C++, or similar languages for scripting, data analysis, and tool development Comfortable and proficient using AI-powered coding and productivity tools to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation workflows Excellent communication skills with the ability to distil complex performance data into actionable architectural recommendations Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Experience with AI/ML training and inference workloads at data-centre scale Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (Hopper, Blackwell, Rubin) and associated software stacks (CUDA, NCCL) Background in chip-to-chip interconnect performance analysis (C2C, UCIe) Exposure to power/thermal-aware performance optimisation techniques Track record of contributions to industry conferences or published performance studies

review_candidates.description: Η Aambience Services είναι μια καινοτόμος εταιρεία, η οποία παρέχει υπηρεσίες εξωτερικής ανάθεσης επιχειρηματικών διαδικασιών (BPO) και υπηρεσίες τεχνολογίας (Information Technology). Αυτό που μας ξεχωρίζει είναι η έντονη επιθυμία μας να αμφισβητήσουμε το status quo, να εμπνεύσουμε και να δημιουργήσουμε πρωτοποριακές λύσεις. Χτίζουμε σχέσεις εμπιστοσύνης με τους πελάτες μας, σε γερές βάσεις ποιότητας και τεχνογνωσίας, παρέχοντας παράλληλα υπηρεσίες υψηλής ποιότητας. Περιγραφή Θέσης Αναζητούμε, για λογαριασμό πελάτη μας στον χώρο των PropTech & Real Estate Services , έναν/μία αναλυτικό/ή και οργανωτικό/ή επαγγελματία για τη θέση Product Analyst & Operations Coordinator , με ενδιαφέρον για το Product Management και την ανάπτυξη ψηφιακών προϊόντων. Ο/Η υποψήφιος/α θα υποστηρίζει τον Head of Product στη συνεχή διαχείριση, εξέλιξη και βελτιστοποίηση της πλατφόρμας της εταιρείας, λειτουργώντας ως σύνδεσμος μεταξύ των ομάδων Product, Development, Operations και των πελατών. Ο ρόλος συνδυάζει την ανάλυση επιχειρησιακών απαιτήσεων, την οργάνωση και παρακολούθηση εργασιών, τη συμμετοχή στον σχεδιασμό νέων λειτουργιών και την υποστήριξη της υλοποίησης και συνεχούς βελτίωσης του προϊόντος. Κύριες Αρμοδιότητες Υποστήριξη του Head of Product στη διαχείριση, οργάνωση και εξέλιξη της πλατφόρμας της εταιρείας, καθώς και στην παρακολούθηση του Product roadmap και των προτεραιοτήτων του προϊόντος Συλλογή, ανάλυση και καταγραφή επιχειρησιακών απαιτήσεων από πελάτες, χρήστες και εσωτερικές ομάδες, με στόχο τη δημιουργία σαφών λειτουργικών προδιαγραφών, user stories, διαδικασιών και τεκμηρίωσης Συμμετοχή σε workshops, συναντήσεις με πελάτες, συνεργάτες και ομάδες έργου για την κατανόηση αναγκών, την παρουσίαση λύσεων και τον συντονισμό ενεργειών Συνεργασία με τις ομάδες ανάπτυξης για την αποσαφήνιση απαιτήσεων, την παρακολούθηση της υλοποίησης νέων λειτουργιών, integrations και αυτοματισμών, καθώς και την επίλυση λειτουργικών θεμάτων Διαχείριση και παρακολούθηση εργασιών μέσω εργαλείων όπως το Jira, καταγραφή αποφάσεων και ενεργειών από meetings, καθώς και συντονισμός με τους εμπλεκόμενους για την έγκαιρη ολοκλήρωση των εργασιών Συμμετοχή σε διαδικασίες testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) και ποιοτικού ελέγχου νέων λειτουργιών, με εντοπισμό bugs και καταγραφή προτάσεων βελτίωσης πριν από την παραγωγική διάθεση Παρακολούθηση feedback χρηστών και πελατών, συλλογή και ανάλυση δεδομένων για την αξιολόγηση της απόδοσης του προϊόντος και την υποστήριξη αποφάσεων για τη συνεχή βελτίωσή του Δημιουργία και συντήρηση εγχειριδίων χρήσης, λειτουργικών προδιαγραφών και εκπαιδευτικού υλικού, καθώς και υποστήριξη στη δημιουργία παρουσιάσεων προϊόντος, demos, προσφορών και απαντήσεων σε RFPs Requirements Απαραίτητα Προσόντα Πτυχίο ΑΕΙ/ΤΕΙ σε συναφές αντικείμενο, όπως Μηχανική Υπολογιστών, Διοίκηση Επιχειρήσεων, Οικονομικά, Business Analytics ή συναφές πεδίο Πολύ καλή γνώση Microsoft Excel και άνεση στη διαχείριση, επεξεργασία και ανάλυση δεδομένων. Ισχυρές οργανωτικές δεξιότητες και ικανότητα διαχείρισης πολλαπλών εργασιών και προτεραιοτήτων. Αναλυτική σκέψη, μεθοδικότητα και ιδιαίτερη προσοχή στη λεπτομέρεια. Πολύ καλές επικοινωνιακές δεξιότητες και ικανότητα συνεργασίας με διαφορετικές ομάδες. Πολύ καλή γνώση ελληνικών και αγγλικών, γραπτά και προφορικά. Επιθυμητή Εμπειρία Περίπου 1 έτος προϋπηρεσίας σε αντίστοιχη θέση (Product Analyst, Business Analyst, Product Operations, Project Coordinator ή συναφή ρόλο). review_candidates.title: Private Club Manager / Club Membership Consultant
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: About the JobRole Description A Private Club Manager / Club Membership Consultant is responsible for managing private club operations, developing membership sales, building relationships with high-net-worth members, and delivering an exceptional luxury club experience. The role involves introducing prospective members to the club, managing membership applications and renewals, coordinating member services and private events, maintaining strong relationships with VIP members, and ensuring the club consistently delivers high standards of hospitality, exclusivity, privacy, and service. Candidates with experience in private clubs, luxury hospitality, five-star hotels, membership sales, VIP concierge, luxury retail, private aviation, yacht services, or high-value client management are encouraged to apply. Key ResponsibilitiesMembership Sales & Development Welcome prospective members and introduce the club, facilities, services, benefits, and membership options. Understand clients’ lifestyle, professional, social, networking, and entertainment requirements. Recommend suitable membership packages based on client preferences and requirements. Conduct private club tours, membership presentations, consultations, and follow-ups. Prepare membership proposals, quotations, applications, agreements, and related documentation. Manage the membership sales process from initial inquiry through application, approval, payment, and onboarding. Follow up on prospective members, referrals, corporate accounts, and pending applications. Achieve individual and team membership sales targets. Develop new membership opportunities through networking, referrals, partnerships, and business development. Promote membership renewals, upgrades, additional services, and suitable club experiences. Maintain accurate CRM records, member profiles, preferences, history, and communication records. VIP Member Relationship Management Build and maintain long-term relationships with HNWIs, entrepreneurs, executives, family offices, investors, celebrities, and influential members. Provide discreet, personalized, and proactive service to VIP members. Understand and maintain records of member preferences, interests, dining habits, event preferences, and important occasions. Anticipate member needs and recommend relevant club services, events, and experiences. Handle member inquiries, requests, complaints, and service recovery professionally. Maintain strict confidentiality regarding member identities, personal information, business activities, and club usage. Support private introductions, networking opportunities, and member-to-member relationship building where appropriate. Club Operations Support or oversee the daily operation of the private club. Ensure club facilities are clean, organized, welcoming, and maintained to luxury standards. Monitor front-of-house service, member reception, dining areas, lounges, meeting rooms, entertainment areas, and other club facilities. Coordinate with hospitality, F&B, housekeeping, security, maintenance, and external service teams. Monitor service quality and address operational issues promptly. Assist with staff scheduling, training, onboarding, and performance development. Ensure employees follow club policies, service standards, privacy procedures, and operational guidelines. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational and membership reports. Monitor operating expenses and support cost-control activities. Events & Member Experience Plan and coordinate private member events, dinners, networking sessions, cultural activities, product launches, and exclusive experiences. Coordinate VIP invitations, guest lists, event schedules, catering, entertainment, décor, and external suppliers. Create personalized experiences for important members and their guests. Support corporate events, private meetings, celebrations, and member functions. Coordinate with luxury brands, hotels, restaurants, private aviation companies, yacht operators, concierge providers, and other premium partners. Gather member feedback and identify opportunities to improve the overall club experience. Club Facilities & Service Standards Maintain high standards across club facilities, presentation, ambiance, and member service. Ensure signage, menus, promotional materials, membership information, and club communications are accurate and professionally presented. Monitor facility condition and coordinate maintenance, repairs, upgrades, and specialist services. Maintain appropriate procedures for member access, guest registration, reservations, and privacy. Report security concerns, facility issues, service problems, or incidents to management. Ensure club operations comply with company policies and applicable UAE regulations. Requirements Diploma or bachelor's degree in Hospitality, Business Administration, Tourism, Marketing, Luxury Brand Management, or a related field is an advantage. Previous experience in private clubs, luxury hospitality, five-star hotels, membership sales, VIP concierge, private residences, private aviation, yacht services, or luxury retail is preferred. Private club membership sales or management experience is a strong advantage. Experience serving HNWIs, VIPs, executives, family offices, or corporate clients is beneficial. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, sales, and relationship-management skills. Strong understanding of luxury hospitality and exclusive membership services. Professional, polished, discreet, and highly detail-oriented. Strong leadership and team-management abilities for managerial positions. Ability to manage multiple members, prospects, events, and operational priorities. Good knowledge of CRM, membership-management, POS, and Microsoft Office systems. Strong organizational, numerical, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under sales targets and service KPIs. Flexible to work evenings, weekends, public holidays, private events, and extended hours. Fluency in English is preferred; Arabic, Russian, Mandarin, French, or other languages are an advantage. Knowledge of the UAE luxury lifestyle, hospitality, private clubs, and HNW market is beneficial. Existing relationships with HNWIs, luxury brands, hospitality groups, or premium-service providers are an advantage. What We Offer Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications. Attractive commission and performance incentives where applicable. Professional private club and luxury hospitality environment. Opportunity to work with HNWIs, VIPs, executives, entrepreneurs, celebrities, and family offices. Exposure to exclusive events, luxury brands, premium hospitality, and private networking opportunities. Professional training in membership sales, VIP relationship management, club operations, and luxury hospitality. Opportunities to participate in private events, networking functions, luxury launches, and member experiences. Career development opportunities within private clubs, luxury hospitality, membership management, and private client services. Employment benefits in accordance with UAE labour regulations.

Proven experience supporting senior leadership or C-level executives, ideally in a fast-paced, international environment. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under time pressure. High level of discretion, integrity, and professionalism when handling confidential information. Ability to work on-site in Dubai and adapt to evolving business needs and schedules. At least 1 year of experience as Personal Assistant in Dubai is must Salary package is 10,000 AED

review_candidates.description: （English follows below Japanese) ポジション目的 店舗クルーを中心とした給与計算および関連する人事・労務オペレーションを、正確かつ期限内に実行する。また、店舗運営部門や関連部署と連携し、給与・労務プロセスの安定運用および継続的な業務改善を推進する。 職務の責任 1. 店舗クルーを中心とした給与計算および給与関連業務の正確かつ期限内の実施 2. 社会保険および雇用関連手続きの適切な運用 3. 入社・退社・休職・復職等に伴う人事手続きおよび各種証明書の発行 4. 外国人クルーの雇用・在留資格関連情報の管理 5. 営業部門、IT部門および関連部署との連携による給与・人事オペレーションの円滑な運用 6. 人事・給与関連システムおよび業務プロセスの改善・最適化 7. アサインされた部門横断プロジェクトへの参画 業務内容 1. 給与計算および給与関連業務 ・ 店舗クルーの勤怠データおよび給与データの確認 ・ 月次給与計算業務の実施および検証 ・ 営業部門・IT部門・外部ベンダー等との連携 ・ 給与関連の会計伝票作成および関連データの管理 ・ 給与に関する従業員・店舗からの問い合わせ対応 2.社会保険・雇用関連手続き ・ 入社、退社、休職、復職等に伴う各種手続き ・ 社会保険・雇用保険に関する手続き ・ 扶養、育児休業、算定基礎届、月額変更届等の対応 ・ 関連書類および従業員情報の適切な管理 3.外国人クルーの雇用管理 ・ 在留資格および就労資格に関する情報管理 ・ 在留期限等のモニタリングおよび必要な手続きのサポート ・ 関係部署との連携による適切な雇用管理 4.人事オペレーションおよび業務改善 ・ 人事・給与関連システムのデータ管理 ・ 業務プロセスの標準化および効率化 ・ マニュアル・業務フロー等の整備 ・ システム改善および関連プロジェクトへの参画 主な顧客 ・営業部門リーダー ・店舗Store Managerおよびクルー ・本部各部門リーダー ・本部スタッフ ・Finance / IT等の関連部署 ・外部ベンダー・関係機関 求められスキル・技能・資格 ・労務管理全般および労働関連法令に関する知識 ・給与計算および社会保険手続きに関する実務知識 ・Microsoft Accessを使用したデータ抽出・加工・管理スキル ・Microsoft Excelを使用したデータ集計・分析・検証スキル ・Microsoft Word等の基本的なPCスキル ・大量のデータを正確に処理する能力 ・関係部署と円滑に連携するコミュニケーションスキル 主なコンピテンシー ・ Attention to Detail — 正確性にこだわり、高い品質で業務を遂行する ・ Accountability — 担当業務に責任を持ち、最後までやり遂げる ・ Problem Solving — 問題を発見し、解決策を考え実行する ・ Continuous Improvement — 既存の業務プロセスを見直し、改善する ・ Collaboration — 関係者と信頼関係を構築し、円滑に連携する ・ Learning Agility — 新しい知識やシステムを積極的に学び、業務に活かす 主な成果、KPI ・ 給与計算の正確性—正確な給与計算を実施し、重大な計算ミスを防止する ・ 給与計算の期限遵守—給与計算および関連業務をスケジュール通りに完了する ・ 社会保険手続きの期限遵守—入退社、扶養、育休、算定、月変等を期限内に処理する ・ データ品質—従業員・給与関連データの正確性を維持する ・ 外国人雇用管理—在留期限等を適切に管理し、必要な対応漏れを防止する ・ 業務改善—業務効率化・標準化につながる改善を継続的に実施する Position Purpose To ensure the accurate and timely execution of payroll and related HR and labor operations, primarily for store crew members. The role works closely with Store Operations and relevant departments to maintain stable payroll and HR processes while driving continuous process improvement. Major Responsibilities 1. Ensure the accurate and timely execution of payroll and payroll-related operations, primarily for store crew members. 2. Manage social insurance and employment-related procedures appropriately. 3. Handle HR procedures related to onboarding, offboarding, leave of absence, return to work, and the issuance of various employment-related certificates. 4. Manage employment and visa/residency status information for foreign crew members. 5. Ensure smooth payroll and HR operations through collaboration with Store Operations, IT, and other relevant departments. 6. Drive improvements and optimization of HR/payroll systems and operational processes. 7. Participate in assigned cross-functional projects. Duties 1. Payroll and Payroll-Related Operations • Review attendance and payroll data for store crew members. • Process and validate monthly payroll. • Collaborate with Store Operations, IT, external vendors, and other relevant stakeholders. • Prepare payroll-related accounting journals and maintain relevant data. • Respond to payroll-related inquiries from employees and stores. 2. Social Insurance and Employment-Related Procedures • Handle various procedures associated with onboarding, offboarding, leave of absence, and return to work. • Process social insurance and employment insurance procedures. • Manage procedures related to dependents, childcare leave, annual social insurance calculations, monthly remuneration changes, and other employment-related matters. • Maintain and manage relevant documentation and employee information appropriately. 3. Employment Administration for Foreign Crew Members • Manage information related to residency status and work authorization. • Monitor visa/residency expiration dates and support required procedures. • Ensure appropriate employment administration in collaboration with relevant departments. 4. HR Operations and Process Improvement • Maintain and manage data within HR and payroll-related systems. • Standardize and improve operational processes. • Develop and maintain manuals and operational workflows. • Participate in system improvements and related projects. Key Customers ・ Store Operations Leaders ・ Store Managers and Crew Members ・ Head Office Department Leaders ・ Head Office Employees ・ Relevant departments, including Finance and IT ・ External vendors and relevant government/administrative bodies Required Skills,Certifications ・ Knowledge of general labor management and relevant labor laws and regulations. ・ Practical knowledge of payroll processing and social insurance procedures. ・ Data extraction, processing, and management skills using Microsoft Access. ・ Data aggregation, analysis, and validation skills using Microsoft Excel. ・ Proficiency in Microsoft Word and other standard PC applications. ・ Ability to accurately process large volumes of data. ・ Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with relevant stakeholders. Key Competencies ・ Attention to Detail — Demonstrates a strong commitment to accuracy and delivers high-quality work. ・ Accountability — Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows through to completion. ・ Problem Solving — Identifies issues, develops practical solutions, and implements them effectively. ・ Continuous Improvement — Reviews existing processes and proactively identifies opportunities for improvement. ・ Collaboration — Builds trusted relationships and works effectively with stakeholders. ・ Learning Agility — Actively learns new knowledge and systems and applies them effectively in the workplace. Key Results, KPI ・ Payroll Accuracy — Ensure accurate payroll processing and prevent significant payroll errors. ・ Payroll Timeliness — Complete payroll processing and related activities according to established schedules. ・ Social Insurance Compliance and Timeliness — Complete procedures related to onboarding/offboarding, dependents, childcare leave, annual social insurance calculations, monthly remuneration changes, and other requirements within applicable deadlines. ・ Data Quality — Maintain the accuracy and integrity of employee and payroll-related data. ・ Foreign Employee Administration — Appropriately monitor residency/visa expiration dates and prevent missed actions or compliance risks. ・ Process Improvement — Continuously implement improvements that enhance operational efficiency and standardization.

Job Responsibilities:  Monitor and analyze production costs, including labor, materials, overhead, and equipment usage. Collaborate with production and procurement teams to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality or safety. Conduct variance analysis between budgeted and actual production costs and recommend corrective actions. Ensure accurate cost allocation across different products, production lines, and departments. Identify cost reduction opportunities through process improvements, material optimization, and efficiency initiatives. Assist in preparing financial reports related to production efficiency and cost performance. Strong analytical and numerical skills; proficiency in cost accounting principles. Experience with ERP systems and advanced MS Excel. Knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and production planning. Strong communication skills for cross-functional collaboration. Detail-oriented, proactive, and results-driven.

Görev ve sorumluluklar: Günlük ön muhasebe işlemlerinin düzenli şekilde yürütülmesi, Alış ve satış faturalarının düzenlenmesi, kontrol edilmesi ve sisteme işlenmesi, Gelir-gider, cari hesap, ödeme ve tahsilat kayıtlarının takip edilmesi, Banka, kasa ve kredi kartı hareketlerinin kontrol edilmesi, Evrakların düzenli şekilde dosyalanması ve mali müşavirle koordinasyon sağlanması, Sağlık turizmine yönelik devlet destekleri ve teşvik süreçlerinin takip edilmesi, Teşvik danışmanlığı firmasıyla düzenli iletişim kurulması, Uçuş/yol desteği, yurt dışı reklam ve tanıtım desteği gibi teşvik kalemlerine ilişkin faturaların ve gerekli belgelerin eksiksiz hazırlanması, Teşvik başvurularının, eksik evrakların ve ödeme süreçlerinin takip edilerek raporlanması, Gerektiğinde yabancı hastalar, tedarikçiler ve iş ortaklarıyla İngilizce yazılı iletişim kurulması. Aranan nitelikler: Ön muhasebe alanında deneyimli, Fatura, cari hesap, banka, kasa ve ödeme süreçlerine hâkim, Sağlık turizmi teşvikleri veya devlet destekleri konusunda deneyimli ya da bu alanda çalışmaya istekli, Teşvik danışmanlığı firmasıyla koordineli çalışabilecek, İyi derecede yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce bilen, MS Office programlarını, özellikle Excel’i etkin kullanabilen, Detaylara önem veren, düzenli ve takip yeteneği güçlü, Tercihen sağlık veya sağlık turizmi sektöründe deneyimli.

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur(e) MES
review_candidates.job_function: Engineering, Project Management, and Information Technology
review_candidates.description: La Société Caduceum, la solution Life Sciences du groupe ALTEN, est une société de conseils 100% dédiée aux industries de Santé. De la conception du produit à sa mise sur le marché, nos équipes accompagnent les industriels des secteurs pharmaceutiques, dispositifs médicaux, biotechnologiques et cosmétiques, dans tous leurs projets d’innovation et de transformation. Être consultant chez Caduceum, c’est la garantie d’évoluer dans votre domaine privilégié ! Grâce à notre Direction Technique, notre couverture nationale et l’accès à de multiples et divers projets au sein des industries de santé, nous assurons aux caducéens un accompagnement dans leur montée en compétences. Vos missions en tant que consultant : En tant qu’ingénieur(e) MES, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’optimisation des opérations de production pharmaceutique. Vos responsabilités incluront : Conception et mise en œuvre des solutions MES : Analyse des besoins métiers, paramétrage et déploiement des systèmes MES (ex. : Werum PAS-X, Siemens Opcenter). Pilotage des projets MES : Gestion des projets liés à l’intégration des systèmes d’information (MES, ERP, LIMS, SCADA). Support et maintenance : Résolution des incidents, suivi des évolutions et maintien de la performance des applications. Conformité réglementaire : Garantir la conformité aux réglementations pharmaceutiques (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11) et aux bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF). Formation et accompagnement des équipes : Assurer la montée en compétences des utilisateurs et fournir un support technique adapté. Profil recherché Formation : Diplôme d’ingénieur ou équivalent, idéalement en informatique industrielle, automatisation ou génie des procédés. Expérience : Minimum 3 ans dans un rôle similaire, idéalement dans l’industrie pharmaceutique ou en environnement réglementé. Compétences techniques : Maîtrise des systèmes MES (Werum PAS-X, Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell, etc.). Connaissances des architectures informatiques et réseaux industriels. Familiarité avec les systèmes SCADA, ERP et LIMS. Qualités personnelles : Rigueur, esprit d’analyse, autonomie et capacité à travailler en équipe.
